name: Maine
sources: 2026 rate schedules, standard deduction ($15,700/$31,400/$23,550), personal exemption $5,300, age-65 add-on $1,650 married / $2,050 unmarried, 2% surcharge thresholds: Maine Revenue Services, 'Maine Individual Income Tax 2026 Rates', revised May 20, 2026 (maine.gov/revenue/sites/maine.gov.revenue/files/2026-05/ind_tax_rate_sched_2026_rev.pdf)

Standard deduction increase (L.D. 705, 2026) and 2% surcharge on Maine taxable income for tax years from 2026 (L.D. 2212, approved April 9, 2026): MRS 'Income Tax Law Changes' (maine.gov/revenue/sites/maine.gov.revenue/files/inline-files/Income%20Tax%20Law%20Changes.pdf)

Standard/itemized deduction phase-out (thresholds $102,250/$204,550/$153,400, ranges $75,000/$150,000/$112,500) and itemized cap $37,100: MRS 2026 estimated-tax worksheet (maine.gov/revenue/sites/maine.gov.revenue/files/inline-files/26_item_stand_ ded_phaseout_wksht_0.pdf)

Personal exemption phase-out (thresholds $341,000/$409,150/$375,050/$204,575, range $125,000; $62,500 MFS): MRS 2026 estimated-tax worksheet (maine.gov/revenue/sites/maine.gov.revenue/files/inline-files/26_1040es_pers_exempt_phaseout_wksht.pdf)

Dependent exemption credit ($300 base, indexed from 2025; reduced $20 per $500 of Maine AGI over $100,000/$150,000/$125,000/$75,000): 36 M.R.S. §5219-SS (legislature.maine.gov/statutes/36/title36sec5219-SS.html); 2025 amount $305: TaxSlayer 'What's new in 2025 for Maine'
provisional: Dependent credit $305 per dependent is the 2025 amount; it is inflation-indexed and the 2026 figure was not found
Dependent credit phase-out thresholds ($100,000 single, $150,000 joint, $125,000 head of household, $75,000 separate) are 2025 values; indexed from 2026, 2026 figures not found
notes: Maine itemized deductions are not included; the standard deduction is used. If you itemize and earn below about $100,000 ($200,000 joint), Maine tax may be overstated.
Maine's dependent credit is shown as $305 per dependent; it is doubled for children under 6 and is refundable.
